layouts.guidance: Demonstrations should emphasize committing early to the Top-edge corridor (row 0 traversal to the goal column, then descent) to avoid central fires, especially when starting near the top rows.
layouts.what_it_teaches: Reinforces consistent Top-edge corridor usage to avoid FIRE hazards in randomized fire placements.
layouts.rationale: Tests following the Top-edge corridor from a top-row start to a lower-left goal while fires are positioned away from the corridor path.
